motivation: Discriminate direct point-for-point replacement of Thalassia by Halodule from spatial redistribution/expansion of Halodule into other meter marks during Lower Tampa Bay community reorganization.

source.required_input: Pinned Darwin Core Event + Occurrence tables; point-year taxon states rebuilt directly from the same source identity as analysis/33.
source.stable_point_id: Point-event locationID constructed upstream as Transect + Site/meter-mark identity
source.consistency_rule: For each stable point locationID x year, retain the point-year only when repeated visits agree separately on Thalassia presence/absence AND Halodule presence/absence. Any taxon-specific disagreement makes that point-year ambiguous and excludes it from both primary endpoints.

H1_direct_takeover_not_dominant.statement: Among exact stable meter marks with Halodule absent in the source year and present in the target year, fewer than half of Halodule gains are direct-takeover candidates where Thalassia is present in the source year and absent in the target year.
H1_direct_takeover_not_dominant.gain_event: source-year Halodule absent AND target-year Halodule present at the same stable point in consecutive years
H1_direct_takeover_not_dominant.direct_takeover_candidate: source-year Thalassia present AND target-year Thalassia absent
H1_direct_takeover_not_dominant.estimator: fraction of Halodule gain events classified as direct_takeover_candidate
H1_direct_takeover_not_dominant.support_rule: upper bound of 95% node-cluster bootstrap interval for direct-takeover fraction < 0.5

H2_gain_prefers_non_thalassia_space.statement: Among exact stable meter marks where Halodule is absent in the source year, next-year Halodule gain is more frequent when Thalassia is also absent in the source year than when Thalassia is present.
H2_gain_prefers_non_thalassia_space.eligible_transition: same stable point observed in consecutive years; source-year Halodule absent; target-year point observed
H2_gain_prefers_non_thalassia_space.estimator: risk difference P(Halodule gain | source Thalassia absent) - P(Halodule gain | source Thalassia present)
H2_gain_prefers_non_thalassia_space.uncertainty: stable-transect node-cluster bootstrap with source-point transitions travelling with the sampled node
H2_gain_prefers_non_thalassia_space.support_rule: lower bound of 95% bootstrap interval for risk difference > 0

secondary_descriptive.note: Report counts/fractions only; do not promote a secondary category if a primary rule fails.

claim_boundary: Post-hoc ecological hypothesis motivated by the already-opened community-buffering result.
Direct-takeover candidate is an observational transition class, not proof that Halodule caused Thalassia loss.
A non-direct Halodule gain supports spatial redistribution/reorganization, not equivalence of ecosystem function among seagrass species.
Do not change the 0.5 dominance threshold, Lower Tampa primary segment, period, eligibility rule, or bootstrap minima after opening the Halodule-gain endpoint.
If either primary endpoint is non-estimable, retain that outcome; do not lower event or node minima.
